newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy, grain basis little changed.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy, grain basis little changed.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf wheat basis offers were steady on Thursday but could be poised to weaken shortly when harvesting gathers pace, grain traders said.

Dealers noted there was little export demand for soft red winter wheat at the moment, but the lack of any significant harvest pressure was holding up basis values. Harvesting of SRW wheat in Mississippi has been held up by recent rains.
Export demand for hard red winter wheat has also been light, although the Commodity Credit Corp announced a tender Thursday for up to 40,000 tonnes of U.S. HRW wheat for export to Armenia.
Corn and soybean basis levels were little changed.
